did: Coordinated the second half of the Nov 19 run through to Nov 20. Rust Rounds got its standing conversational opening end to end: a third voice asks up to three questions, your newest heard take of each answer plays and is reused week to week, every take is kept, and an unheard one falls back to the last good take, with the words you approved. The teleprompter stopped jumping to the top, sped up with Slower and Faster, and became one shared piece; interview takes run three minutes and both essays may run an hour. The S21's trouble after a reinstall was traced to Android restoring storage but not the pairing, and fixed on both sides, so pairing again keeps what the phone knew home holds. You set two working rules into CLAUDE.md: look for an existing tool before building machinery, and treat limits as suggestions that move with the story. Home's release now follows the www and resume images on its own. Every worker wound down with its note.

calls.title: Hold some-ui merges while a server PR lands
options: Pause some-ui merges until the server PR merges
Keep merging both and update the server PR each time
calls.why: Each some-ui merge publishes an image, and home's release PR then lands on server main and leaves a strict server PR behind; pausing for one CI cycle landed it.
calls.undo: Merge some-ui PRs as they go green and keep updating the server PR.

calls.title: How home's release follows www
options: By its most recently pushed tag
calls.why: A re-run of an older publish would otherwise move home backwards (review of server#1043).
calls.undo: Drop the SEMVER sort in release_lock.py's newest.

left: Your deploy and the APK on 58bff40 (mobile-release) bring all of it to the phone; the routine writing /2 weeks with the opening (#3272) follows.
Residual Ledger writes are queued until you're back, at your request: interview-week (#3305), release-set (C740 landed), and the run's other items.

Filed for later: #3288 real screens in the Rust essay, #3296 questions read aloud, #3299 and #3302 small races, #3300 stale Jobs picks, #3305 interview auto-send, server#1023 chunked renders, server#1044 commit-tag ordering.
